name: Experimental Setup 2
description: Experimental Setup 1 with the short WSG50_GELSIGHT_fin fingers and two GelSight Mini sensors.
units: m, rad, kg, s; fields suffixed deg are degrees

finger_source_to_sensor.note: Current short finger pocket registration from diffpatch_ex.mujoco_system.prepare_session_assets; inferred mating, not a measured installation transform.

mount.note: Nominal parallel sensors. Retains the source's inferred 14 mm carriage extension; does not import the recording-specific -3 degree sensor tilt.

gripper.note: Opening is the nominal WSG register (twice slide q). Gap is measured between opposing curved gel apexes. The 0.5 mm offset preserves the existing finger/housing mounts when replacing the 4.25 mm flat pads with 4.0 mm curved CAD. This remains an uncalibrated nominal opening-to-gap mapping.

gel_geometry.note: FEATS curved CAD, rigid registration without geometric rescaling; back plane remains at sensor x=2.125 mm. Published nominal geometry, not a measurement of the individual gel.

sensor.note: Masses and inertia are source simulation assumptions. Gel visual geometry is the curved CAD mesh; MuJoCo collision uses its convex hull. No optical tactile rendering or continuum deformation model.
